annotations.text:
Direction: 90s desktop quirk x cassette tape.
Gray bevels = tool chrome. Dark green LCD = anything that plays or shows sound.
The ring buffer IS the tape - the metaphor is the mental model, not a costume.
Trim = tape under a fixed needle: you drag the AUDIO, the playhead never moves. Precision without tiny handles.
During capture the bubble IS the app. One tap = snip, never opens a screen. Trim always happens later.
